title: CRM service rollout | future risk register | fictional, as of 2026-10-14

rows.risk: RISK-01 | A further CRM recovery delay could push trial integration testing
rows.trigger: No cause/recovery reply on 2026-10-15, or the 2026-10-18 completion forecast moves later.
rows.impact: Real-endpoint testing could restart late and put the 2026-10-26 trial review at risk.
rows.response: Development and the CRM Vendor compare recovery options; PM escalates the plan impact. Use mocks only for independent UI work, never as API acceptance evidence.
rows.evidence: Required: vendor cause/recovery response, dated forecast, real-endpoint authentication and retry test records. None is asserted complete.
rows.residual: The external recovery date is not within the project team's sole control.

rows.risk: RISK-02 | Incorrect duplicate handling could reach production
rows.trigger: The 80 candidate decisions remain unapproved, or source-to-target/exclusion traceability fails at recheck.
rows.impact: Customer or service histories could be lost or wrongly merged.
rows.response: Business decides the rule by 2026-10-16. Reconcile original data, processing results and approved exclusions; stop migration when criteria are unmet.
rows.evidence: Required: signed rule, dispositions for 80 candidates, traceability for 20,000 source records, counts and business sample results.
rows.residual: Matching 20,000 record counts alone cannot detect every content error.

rows.risk: RISK-03 | The capacity gap could cause omitted validation or a late trial review
rows.trigger: The estimated 3-person-day gap remains uncovered on 2026-10-16 for the 2026-10-19 to 2026-10-23 conflict.
rows.impact: The 2026-10-26 trial-testing forecast could slip or mandatory business checks could be missed.
rows.response: PM agrees replacement/reallocation with the other project. Quality replans sequence and dates; do not remove mandatory cases to conceal the shortfall.
rows.evidence: Required: named resource/time agreements and a feasible validation plan acknowledged by Quality.
rows.residual: Replacement staff may need familiarization and add retest effort.

rows.risk: RISK-04 | Unapproved SMS work could enter the first release
rows.trigger: Implementation starts before the 2026-10-16 decision, or SMS is included while CR-01 remains unresolved.
rows.impact: The provisional +8 person-days / +JPY 600,000 and personal-data/delivery impacts could bypass the baseline.
rows.response: Retain in-app/email scope. Sponsor decides after impact assessment; Information Management can block unmet safety conditions. Communicate rejection or deferral as well as approval.
rows.evidence: Required: CR-01 option comparison, information-management conditions, Sponsor decision and requester receipt; a revised baseline only if effective approval is obtained.
rows.residual: Even approved SMS work retains estimation uncertainty and regression risk.

rows.risk: RISK-05 | A night batch could overrun the low-usage maintenance window
rows.trigger: Forecast finish exceeds the agreed window, or a critical post-update reconciliation fails.
rows.impact: Normal business could start late or use inconsistent data.
rows.response: Take a pre-run snapshot. Stop/roll back on overrun or critical mismatch; reconcile restored data and confirm business readiness before notifying restart.
rows.review:
2026-10-20: procedure/contact review
Before and after every run
rows.evidence: Required: agreed maintenance window, snapshot reference, run/stop times, reconciliation and restart-notice records.
rows.residual: A deferred rerun and manual entries made in the old system still require reconciliation.

rows.risk: RISK-06 | Cutover could proceed without production safety evidence
rows.trigger: Production access, audit or personal-data evidence is missing at the proposed Go / No Go review.
rows.impact: The service could expose data or grant inappropriate permissions.
rows.response: Information Management confirms blocking conditions. Defer with No Go when unmet; the 2026-10-11 trial-environment access pass is not a production release approval.
rows.review:
Before Go / No Go
2026-12-16 is a proposal, not an approval
rows.evidence: Required: production-specific access tests, audit evidence, data-protection approval and recorded Go / No Go decision.
rows.residual: Configuration changes and new threats still need monitoring after approval.

rows.risk: RISK-07 | Incomplete checks after rollback could make a premature restart worse
rows.trigger: Restored-system counts, business samples or restart communication remain incomplete.
rows.impact: The team could resume on an apparently restored system and increase lost or duplicated service work.
rows.response: Separate technical restoration from business restart. Complete reconciliation, business checks and notification, then preserve incident and review records.
rows.evidence: Required: restore log, count/sample checks, business restart confirmation, notification receipt and follow-up action log.
rows.residual: Requests recorded manually during cutover still need later reconciliation.
